description: This source file implements ASN.1 encoding and packing functions for system information blocks (SIBs) and Master Information Block (MIB) in a 5G NR context, including segmentation of large messages and handling of various SIB types.

methods.name: pack_mib
methods.description: Encodes the Master Information Block (MIB) based on the provided cell configuration, including SCS and CORESET/SEARCHSPACE indices.
